prompts.atlas: Create one production game UI sprite atlas on transparent background, square 1024x1024, a 2 by 2 grid with four separate centered sprites each occupying its 512x512 cell and 60px clear margin. No text no numbers no letters. Style: polished hand painted One Piece nautical anime game interface, navy teal sea enamel and warm brass gold edges, readable simple silhouettes, not realism. Top left: circular energy meter frame, exactly nine evenly spaced recessed outer ring sockets around full circle; central inner disk split into two symmetric inset button regions left/right, both empty dark navy for separate icons; clean ring no handles no rod. Top right: simple bright gold fishing reel rapid-pull icon, stylized spool with two backward motion chevrons, designed to fit circular button. Bottom left: simple bright turquoise powerful fist with sharp manga lightning burst silhouette, designed to fit circular button. Bottom right: bold small manga impact starburst with orange red sparks and cream center, suited as a fish hit overlay. All four distinct, no connected artwork between cells, true transparent background. Strong clean outlines, restrained detail, match brass and turquoise nautical HUD.
